question: Could you provide a combined 2021 report comparing racial (Asian, Black, Hispanic/Latinx, White) and gender (U.S. Women, U.S. Men) distributions across Google’s overall workforce hiring, Google’s overall workforce representation, and the BLS data specifically for the technology sectors defined as Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals or Computer systems design and related services?
sql:
WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Hiring' AS category,
    workforce,
    report_year,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS gender_us,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Representation' AS category,
    workforce,
    report_year,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS gender_us,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_hiring_intersectional AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Hiring (by Gender)' AS category,
    workforce,
    report_year,
    gender_us,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS gender_us_women,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS gender_us_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation_intersectional AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Representation (by Gender)' AS category,
    workforce,
    report_year,
    gender_us,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS gender_us_women,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS gender_us_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_internet AS (
  SELECT 
    'BLS - Internet Publishing & Web Search' AS category,
    subsector,
    year,
    'both' AS gender_us,
    percent_asian,
    percent_black_or_african_american AS percent_black,
    percent_hispanic_or_latino AS percent_hispanic_latinx,
    percent_white,
    percent_women,
    (1 - percent_women) AS gender_us_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 AND subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    'BLS - Computer Systems Design (Professional & Technical Services)' AS category,
    subsector,
    year,
    'both' AS gender_us,
    percent_asian,
    percent_black_or_african_american AS percent_black,
    percent_hispanic_or_latino AS percent_hispanic_latinx,
    percent_white,
    percent_women,
    (1 - percent_women) AS gender_us_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 
    AND subsector = 'Professional and technical services'
    AND total_employed_in_thousands = (SELECT MAX(total_employed_in_thousands) FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18` WHERE year = 2021 AND subsector = 'Professional and technical services')
)
SELECT category, workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men
FROM google_hiring
UNION ALL
SELECT category, workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men
FROM google_representation
UNION ALL
SELECT category, workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men
FROM google_hiring_intersectional
UNION ALL
SELECT category, workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men
FROM google_representation_intersectional
UNION ALL
SELECT category, subsector, year, gender_us, percent_asian, percent_black, percent_hispanic_latinx, percent_white, percent_women, gender_us_men
FROM bls_internet
UNION ALL
SELECT category, subsector, year, gender_us, percent_asian, percent_black, percent_hispanic_latinx, percent_white, percent_women, gender_us_men
FROM bls_tech
ORDER BY category, report_year, gender_us
